title: Radiation-like sickness after a mystery box escort mission
place_text: aboard an aircraft, location not stated

tellings.quote: I got very sick afterwards and um, lost every hair on my body. Skin peeled off my arms.

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once carried a UFO with his aircraft, says that sometime in the 1990s he was on a flight escorting a mysterious box. Afterwards, he says, he got very sick, "lost every hair on my body," and the skin peeled off his arms, much like radiation sickness. He tells Michels this as something that happened to him, and if true it would point to the box holding something dangerous and unknown.
